name: offset-shadow-lower-third
title: Offset Shadow Lower Third
description: A bold news-style lower third: a white headline bar with a colored offset shadow over a colored sub-line with a white one. It holds still.
useWhen: A headline and a sub-line must sit over footage in a punchy, tabloid-news style.
The host animates the entrance and exit itself.
avoidWhen: You need an animated entrance: pair it with a slide or reveal block in the host.
A calm, minimal title: the heavy offset shadows are loud.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
